notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Metamorph is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Phyrexian Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Phyrexian Metamorph.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by tapping it.
When Phyrexian Metamorph becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Phyrexian Metamorph's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
